extracted.intended_audience: agency personnel managers and Office of Personnel / DD/S Plans Staff
extracted.subtask_description: An internal Office of Personnel management improvement/implementation plan (Jan–Jun 1971) specifying Management Effectiveness Goals and procedural actions to implement OMB Circular A-44 within an agency. Lists concrete tasks, deadlines, and procedural changes for personnel operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals (overall orientation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Since our mission is to provide services, our management improvement plans are expressed best in terms of the following Management Effectiveness Goals:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans should emphasize improving effectiveness and efficiency of personnel services rather than curtailing services; goals are service-oriented operational improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue study of feasibility of expanding payroll deduction system
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue study of the feasibility of expanding the payroll deduction system to include insurance premiums and to use automated accounting procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate both adding insurance premium deductions and automation of accounting to improve service delivery and administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish an insurance handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish an insurance handbook to provide current information on all insurance programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: reduce correspondence between field installations and Headquarters on insurance matters by providing a single, current reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish Overseas Hospitalization Program Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete coordination and publish 'Overseas Hospitalization Program Handbook.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended effect: improve service to employees in the field and eliminate much correspondence between the field and Headquarters concerning the hospitalization program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Begin exit processing of Type A Headquarters contract personnel like staff
rubrics_metrics.description: In January 1971 begin the exit processing of Type A Headquarters contract personnel in the same manner as staff personnel are processed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To be accomplished without additional personnel; will expedite check-out procedures and ensure contract personnel are given proper information at departure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Official Personnel File handling for Type A contract employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete a thorough study on the 'Official Personnel File' of Type A contract employees at Headquarters to determine: (a) where the originals of contracts, etc., should be kept; and (b) whether the operating component concerned or CED should maintain the 'Official File' on such employees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine custody and storage location policies for official files of contract employees to clarify record ownership and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resolve scope differences on Agency regulation for contract employment
rubrics_metrics.description: Resolve substantial differences over the scope of the proposed Agency regulation on contract employment and present it for full Agency coordination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bring disputed scope issues to resolution and route the proposed regulation through full agency coordination for adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate PERCON omissions and complete priority database by deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial cover and security and medical data omissions from PERCON are being eliminated and the data base of priority items will be completed by 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During the reporting period, give constant attention to maximizing use of PERCON data to meet component needs for reliable information; correct omissions and populate priority fields by the stated deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete guidelines for special annuity program implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete guidelines for implementation of the special annuity program for certain contract personnel which was approved recently by the Executive Director–Comptroller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce procedural guidance to operationalize the approved special annuity program for eligible contract personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Install improved internal record keeping for employment assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Install an improved internal record keeping system that will provide more reliable information on employment assistance in individual cases, identify techniques that prove effective in locating employment, and keep list of contacts current.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: System should track case-level employment assistance, capture effective search techniques, and maintain up-to-date contact lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Survey retired employees with comprehensive questionnaire
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute to our retired population a comprehensive questionnaire designed to elicit information as to their employment status, problems and successes encountered in retirement, suggestions for prospective retirees, ideas for improving the retirement planning program and generally to validate certain aspects of this program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questionnaires will be sent only to those persons who retired since 1 July 1968 (when the present planning and counseling program was put into effect); use results to validate and improve retirement planning services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish advance review procedures for prospective retirees' files
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish procedures for advance review of files of prospective retirees upon their entry into the five-year retirement planning phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: validate their creditable service so that if repayment of contributions is to be made, persons will have the benefit of the five-year period during which to make payments; implement proactive file-checking early in planning phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement Voluntary Investment Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Put into effect the Voluntary Investment Plan to enable qualified employees to participate in an investment plan designed to provide an eventual supplement to retirement annuities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operationalize enrollment and eligibility processes for voluntary investment to supplement retirement income.

rubrics_metrics.name: Require position descriptions with organizational change requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Require that components submit position descriptions at the time organizational changes are requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure position descriptions accompany change requests to support staffing, classification, and organizational decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce reports via Reports Inventory and SRB review (5% target)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two studies are being carried on which are designed to reduce reports; the Reports Inventory project (requested by the President) and the review in collaboration with SIPS of all SRB reports and information requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports Inventory will identify deletable reports; aim is to reduce reports by 5% by the end of Fiscal Year 1971; collaborate with SIPS to develop an effective system of useful personnel reports with minimum duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve control over Official Personnel Folders
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue to study procedures to provide for better control of Official Personnel Folders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address deficiency in present system which provides no positive control of Official Personnel Folders that are on loan to Operating Officials; develop procedures assuring positive control and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore soundproofing for Status flexowriter room
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue to explore the feasibility of providing soundproofing materials for the Status flexowriter room.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested by the IG team and discussed with Building Maintenance; expected benefit: increase efficiency and productivity by creating an atmosphere more conducive to concentration for typists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not emphasize significant cost reduction goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Since we do not intend to curtail personnel services, our plans to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of personnel operations do not include significant Cost Reduction Goals per se.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The emphasis of improvement plans is on service effectiveness and efficiency, not on major cost-cutting; consider cost implications but do not prioritize cutting services.
